versioning.staging: github.sha from the main-branch deployment run
versioning.production: release tag (vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) plus the tag's immutable github.sha
versioning.components: Workers, Pages frontends, and widget are built from the same workflow checkout unless a job explicitly builds independently

schema.rollbackPolicy: never reverse an applied schema migration; deploy compatible code or use a reviewed forward repair

phases.purpose: Build, typecheck, test, validate migration inventory, and reject shared or unverified environment resources.
Apply the ordered D1 ledger, then run required consumer schema probes before deploying workers.
Probe the staging router, all router-bound service health checks, and AgentPort before publishing dependent frontends.

healthEvidence.preflight: Required CI tests, typechecks and static environment/migration validation.
healthEvidence.postMigration: Required-schema zero-row D1 probes in the deployment job.
healthEvidence.postWorker: Before dependent frontend publication, retry HTTPS health probes for the router, all eleven router-bound services via /health/dependencies, and the separately routed AgentPort /health endpoint; validate the release environment identity and response shape.

phases.purpose: Build, typecheck, test, validate migration inventory, and reject shared or unverified environment resources.
Apply the ordered D1 ledger, then run required consumer schema probes before deploying workers.
Probe the production router, all router-bound service health checks, and AgentPort before publishing dependent frontends.
Build and publish Pages applications and the versioned plus latest widget assets.

healthEvidence.preflight: Required CI tests, typechecks and static environment/migration validation.
healthEvidence.postMigration: Required-schema zero-row D1 probes in the deployment job.
healthEvidence.postWorker: Before dependent frontend publication, retry HTTPS health probes for the router, all eleven router-bound services via /health/dependencies, and the separately routed AgentPort /health endpoint; validate the release environment identity and response shape.

recovery.codeRepair: Stop promotion on any failed migration, schema probe, or component deploy. Keep the applied schema. After reviewing compatibility and the durable migration ledger, issue a reviewed forward fix or a new code release compatible with the current schema.
recovery.dataRecovery: Schema rollback does not recover changed or deleted data. Use an independently verified backup restore procedure and replay erasure tombstones before reopening traffic.
recovery.interruptedMigration: Resume only with the durable lock owner after inspecting the ledger and lock record. The migration runner retains the lock after failure and never guesses whether a legacy migration ran.
